ayahs.arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عِوَجَا ۜ
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi-lladhī anzala ʿalā ʿabdihi-l-kitāba walam yajʿal lahu ʿiwajan
ayahs.translation: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who has sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance.

ayahs.arabic: قَيِّمًۭا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأْسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Qayyiman liyundhira baʾsan shadīdan min ladunhu wayubashshira-l-muʾminīna-lladhīna yaʿmalūna-ṣ-ṣāliḥāti anna lahum ajran ḥasanā
ayahs.translation: [He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward

ayahs.arabic: مَّٰكِثِينَ فِيهِ أَبَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Mākithīna fīhi abadā
ayahs.translation: In which they will remain forever

ayahs.arabic: وَيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wayundhira-lladhīna qālū-ttakhadha-llāhu waladā
ayahs.translation: And to warn those who say, "Allah has taken a son."

ayahs.arabic: مَّا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا لِءَابَآئِهِمْ ۚ كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ ۚ إِن يَقُولُونَ إِلَّا كَذِبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Mā lahum bihi min ʿilmin walā liʾābāʾihim kaburat kalimatan takhruju min afwāhihim in yaqūlūna illā kadhibā
ayahs.translation: They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا
ayahs.transliteration: Falaʿallaka bākhiʿun nafsaka ʿalā āthārihim in lam yuʾminū bihādhā-l-ḥadīthi asafā
ayahs.translation: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ زِينَةًۭ لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Innā jaʿalnā mā ʿalā-l-ʾarḍi zīnatan lahā linabluwahum ayyuhum aḥsanu ʿamalā
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَجَٰعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيدًۭا جُرُزًا
ayahs.transliteration: Waʾinnā lajāʿilūna mā ʿalayhā ṣaʿīdan juruzā
ayahs.translation: And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْكَهْفِ وَٱلرَّقِيمِ كَانُوا۟ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا عَجَبًا
ayahs.transliteration: Am ḥasibta anna aṣḥāba-l-kahfi war-raqīmi kānū min āyātinā ʿajabā
ayahs.translation: Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder?

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ أَوَى ٱلْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةًۭ وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Idh awā-l-fityatu ilā-l-kahfi faqālū rabbanā ātinā min ladunka raḥmatan wahayyiʾ lanā min amrinā rashadā
ayahs.translation: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِى غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكْرِى وَكَانُوا۟ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا
ayahs.transliteration: Alladhīna kānat aʿyunuhum fī ghiṭāʾin ʿan dhikrī wakānū lā yastaṭīʿūna samʿā
ayahs.translation: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance, and they were not able to hear.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا۟ عِبَادِى مِن دُونِىٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۚ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ نُزُلًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Afaḥasiba-lladhīna kafarū an yattakhidhū ʿibādī min dūnī awliyāʾa innā aʿtadnā jahannama lil-kāfirīna nuzulā
ayahs.translation: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَٰلًا
ayahs.transliteration: Qul hal nunabbiʾukum bil-ʾakhsarīna aʿmālā
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا
ayahs.transliteration: Alladhīna ḍalla saʿyuhum fī-l-ḥayāti-d-dunyā wahum yaḥsabūna annahum yuḥsinūna ṣunʿā
ayahs.translation: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَزْنًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Ūlāʾika-lladhīna kafarū biʾāyāti rabbihim waliqāʾihi faḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum falā nuqīmu lahum yawma-l-qiyāmati waznā
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance.

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِى وَرُسُلِى هُزُوًا
ayahs.transliteration: Dhālika jazāʾuhum jahannamu bimā kafarū wāttakhadhū āyātī warusulī huzuwā
ayahs.translation: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا
ayahs.transliteration: Inna-lladhīna āmanū waʿamilū-ṣ-ṣāliḥāti kānat lahum jannātu-l-firdawsi nuzulā
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,

ayahs.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Khālidīna fīhā lā yabghūna ʿanhā ḥiwalā
ayahs.translation: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.

ayahs.arabic: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ ٱلْبَحْرُ مِدَادًۭا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّى لَنَفِدَ ٱلْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّى وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِۦ مَدَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Qul law kāna-l-baḥru midādan likalimāti rabbī lanafida-l-baḥru qabla an tanfada kalimātu rabbī walaw jiʾnā bimithlihi madadā
ayahs.translation: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as a supplement."

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا
ayahs.transliteration: Qul innamā anā basharun mithlukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun faman kāna yarjū liqāʾa rabbihi falyaʿmal ʿamalan ṣāliḥan walā yushrik biʿibādati rabbihi aḥadā
ayahs.translation: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."
